title: Boba Move - Adjustable Bed Elise Upholstered Bed King Size (Brown) + Sense Mattress 8" (20.3 cm)
body_html:
Your bed isn’t just for sleeping anymore.
It’s for movie nights, late-night scrolling, weekend reads, WFH days—and those “I’m not getting up” moods.

Boba Move gets it.

With a head tilt of up to 60°, this recliner-like bed lets you sit up comfortably without turning pillows into a DIY setup. Watching TV, reading a book, or answering emails from bed? Easy, comfy, and easy on your neck.

The 30° Anti-Snore Mode gently lifts your head to support better breathing—so nights stay quieter for you (and everyone else in the room). A small adjustment that makes a big difference.

Switch to TV Mode and your bed becomes the best seat in the house. Save your favourite lounging angles with 2 memory settings, so comfort is always just one tap away—no readjusting required.

And because moving is overrated, the wireless remote lets you control everything effortlessly. Built for real life, Boba Move sits on a sturdy base that supports up to 317 kg, stays stable on solid floors, and keeps every movement smooth and stress-free.

Boba Move is available in multiple comfort combos—just the adjustable frame, with our Sense mattress, or paired with Elise or Orra upholstered beds, so you can choose the setup that fits your space and your vibe.

This isn’t just a bed.
It’s your comfort command centre—watch, work, read, snooze, repeat.
